MAP: success grid, exit gates & acceptance tests — Clearwell POC

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Conway <alex@clearwellhealth.com>, Priya Singh <priya@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: success grid, exit gates & acceptance tests — Clearwell POC

Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo on Friday. Per our conversation, I attached a first-pass MAP (MAP_v1.xlsx) with three sections I want to align on this week:

1) Success grid (KPI thresholds for latency, throughput and quality)
2) Exit gates (hard/soft failures that will pause/terminate the POC)
3) Acceptance tests (smoke + sample data suites and ownership)

Top asks: can you confirm the business owners for the three KPIs, and whether the sample dataset we discussed is representative? If so we can lock the verification protocol and schedule the validation window for the week of Apr 5.

Proposed owners (internal): Ben — verification design & smoke tests; Jordan — deployment cadence and rollback triggers.

I highlighted the critical exit gate: if 99th percentile latency for 512-token requests exceeds 800ms across three consecutive days during the validation window, we move to a performance remediation plan (and potentially pause the trial).

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan v1)

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Conway <alex@clearwellhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: success grid, exit gates & acceptance tests — Clearwell POC

Kimberly —

Thanks for the doc. Quick notes after a first read:

- The business owner for accuracy will be Priya (we run clinical QA); I added her to recipients.
- The sample dataset referenced in the MAP does align with our staged dataset (we will provide anonymized records by Mar 29).
- Regarding the 800ms 99p exit gate: can we add a secondary check that tolerates transient infra blips? For example: require three *consecutive* days AND a minimum of 5k total inference tokens processed per day. Otherwise a small volume day could trigger a false positive.

Also, small ask: can the acceptance tests include a concordance check against our current rule-based system for a 500-sample set? If the model output has <2% regression on key labels we treat that as pass for accuracy.

I attached the internal test-owner list (will share full dataset link once legal signs NDAs).

—Alex
Alex Conway
Sr. PM, Data Platforms — Clearwell Health
alex@clearwellhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Conway <alex@clearwellhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 14:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: success grid, exit gates & acceptance tests — Clearwell POC

Thanks Alex — good call on the volume threshold. I sketched a verification protocol and sample smoke tests in the attached acceptance-tests-resources.pdf. Highlights:

- Verification phases:
  * Phase 0: Sanity (synthetic smoke run, <1 hour)
  * Phase 1: Functional (500-sample concordance check with Clearwell labels)
  * Phase 2: Load verification (24-hour window, target 5k inference tokens/day)
  * Phase 3: Regression monitoring (rolling 7-day window for quality drift)

- Exit conditions (explicit):
  * Hard: 99p latency > 800ms for 3 consecutive calendar days during Phase 2
  * Soft: Accuracy regression > 2% on concordance set for 3 consecutive days — triggers root-cause investigation and mitigation plan

- Owners: Ben (verification design), Priya (business accuracy owner), Jordan (deployment & rollback), Kimberly (customer comms & go/no-go decision)

I also included example curl commands and a token-level cost check appendix.

Attachments: acceptance-tests-resources.pdf

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

All —

Agree with Ben's phased approach. Action items / timeline I propose: 

1) Mar 29 — Clearwell shares anonymized sample dataset (Priya)
2) Apr 1 — Phase 0 & Phase 1 runs (internal verification, Ben leads)
3) Apr 5–11 — Phase 2 (24-hour load verification window)
4) Apr 12 — Decision checkpoint (go/no-go) — Kimberly to convene stakeholders for sign-off

If any hard exit gate is met during Apr 5–11 we automatically pause the POC and enact the remediation runbook. Please confirm these dates so I can lock engineering availability.

Jordan Blake
